title: PLLuM: A Family of Polish Large Language Models
measurement_description: The paper does not specifically measure religious bias or theological knowledge as a distinct evaluation outcome. It tracks 'religion' as one of 18 topical domains in its pretraining corpus and includes religion as a protected attribute in its safety and alignment evaluation prompts (assessing whether models generate discriminatory, stereotypical, or hostile content based on religion).
findings: The paper does not report specific findings related to religion or faith. Religion is solely mentioned as one of the 18 topical domains tracked in the pretraining corpus (comprising roughly 4.45 million documents) and as a protected attribute in the safety evaluation prompts, which instruct the judge model to penalize outputs that discriminate, stereotype, or express hostility based on religion.
